<document id="RB-GEN-PS52-DEERWATER Rev D" title="Runbook: Standby Generator GEN-PS52-DEERWATER (300 kW Diesel, PS-52)" family="runbook">
<passage n="00" section="Control box">
SGW  WATER DISTRIBUTION

RB-GEN-PS52-DEERWATER Rev D
RUNBOOK: STANDBY GENERATOR GEN-PS52-DEERWATER (300 KW DIESEL, PS-52)

+----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Document: RB-GEN-PS52-DEERWATER Rev D                                                        |
| Effective: 2024-02-26                                                                        |
| Owner: Water Distribution                                                                    |
| Subject Matter Expert: Lumpkin, Harlan E.                                                    |
| Periodic review due: 2025-05-31                                                              |
| Classification: SGW Internal - Controlled                                                    |
| Approved: Manager, Water Distribution, Sistrunk, Odell M., 2024-02-26                        |
+----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
</passage>
<passage n="01" section="Revision Summary; 1.0 PURPOSE; 2.0 DATA">
REVISION SUMMARY

+-----+------------+---------+--------------------------------------------+
| Rev | Date       | Section | Change                                     |
+=====+============+=========+============================================+
| D   | 2024-02-26 | 2.0     | Data table updated after annual load test. |
+-----+------------+---------+--------------------------------------------+

1.0 PURPOSE

Operate the unit safely and keep it available during declared events.

2.0 DATA

+--------------------------+---------------------------------+
| Item                     | Value                           |
+==========================+=================================+
| Rated output (kW)        | 300                             |
| Fuel tank (gal)          | 840                             |
| Burn at 75% load (gal/h) | 16.9                            |
| Transfer                 | Automatic transfer switch, 10 s |
+--------------------------+---------------------------------+
</passage>
<passage n="02" section="3.0 OPERATION; 4.0 RECORDS">
3.0 OPERATION

3.1 Confirm automatic start and transfer.

3.2 Log fuel every 4 h; refuel request at 60%.

3.3 Route via Deerwater Spur only when open; alternate route via SC 302 per Logistics.

3.4 After any run over 8 h, check coolant and oil before the next start.

CAUTION: Carbon monoxide. Never run a generator inside a building or near an air intake.

4.0 RECORDS

Run hours and fuel on F-WDS-207; defects to the maintenance work queue.
</passage>
</document>
Write one header per passage, in passage order.
